title: Wix's stealth price hikes and bot-only support are driving small businesses to churn
description: Small business owners and non-technical founders are fleeing Wix due to unannounced subscription price increases and a total inability to reach human support for refunds. Users are trapped in infinite loops with AI chatbots that fail to address financial hardship or billing errors. The platform's reputation is tanking among its core demographic, who feel the company has prioritized extracting maximum recurring revenue over maintaining fair, transparent business practices.
the_opportunity: The shift toward 'micro-SaaS' and solopreneurship makes price-sensitive users prioritize long-term, fixed-cost predictability over ecosystem lock-in. Capturing this market requires a 'no-surprises' billing model, as the current dissatisfaction with Wix underscores a massive opening for an engine with modular, transparent, and flat-fee pricing.
the_gap: Website builders have fully adopted the 'cable company' model: cheap introductory rates followed by relentless, silent price hikes. There is a lucrative gap for a visually intuitive website builder that guarantees a lifetime price lock or offers a one-time perpetual license, specifically targeting users burned by aggressive SaaS billing tactics.
